name: Lemongrass
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts due to low FODMAP content and aromatic compounds that may support digestive comfort.
preparationTips: Use only the tender white and pale green parts, discard tough outer layers
Bruise or crush stalks before adding to curries and soups for maximum flavor release
Remove whole stalks before serving as they remain fibrous and inedible
Finely mince when using raw in salads or marinades
